a7.ground.text: No more muddy shoes in my stall!

a7.tree.text: I climbed this tree as a girl. Don't tell Bhai.

a7.stall.text: My stall! It's... it's beautiful! Free tea for a month!

a7.bench.text: Now all the gossip has a proper home.

a7.lamp.text: See? Not a single spark. Well, one small spark.

a7.bunting.text: It's like the sky is wearing a necklace!

a7.fence.text: That goat ate my lunch. This is personal.

a7.arrive.text: Welcome to Chiya Tole's heart, Maya. Or what's left of it.
The whole tole chipped in for paint. Let's make it count.

a7.outro.text: The whole tole is out here! Children, grandparents, even the goats.
This is what a neighbourhood should feel like.
Didi! Tihar is next week! Can we decorate the whole street?
The whole street, Bhai. Every light, every garland.
